Reject creating an owner whose telephone number is already used by any other owner. Respond with 409.

agent.result_text:
The full suite is green (261 tests, 0 failures).

## Summary

The requirement: reject creating an owner whose telephone is already used by **any other owner**, responding with 409.

The `addOwner` endpoint already returned `409 CONFLICT` when `ownerAlreadyExists(...)` was true, but the existing check only matched when **both** last name *and* telephone were identical. I widened it to match on telephone alone across all owners.

**Change** — `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:
```java
private boolean ownerAlreadyExists(Owner owner) {
    return this.clinicService.findAllOwners().stream()
        .anyMatch(existing -> Objects.equals(existing.getTelephone(), owner.getTelephone()));
}
```
(uses the already-present `findAllOwners()` service method; javadoc updated accordingly).

**Test** — added `createOwnerWithTelephoneUsedByAnotherOwnerReturnsConflict` to `OwnerRestControllerV1Tests`, which seeds an owner with one identity and telephone, then POSTs a completely different owner (different name/address/city) reusing that telephone and asserts `409 Conflict`.

I verified the two POST-path test telephones (`6085551099`, `6085551077`) are absent from the seed data, so the pre-existing `createOwnerSuccess` and duplicate tests remain valid under the telephone-only rule. Full suite: **261 tests, 0 failures**.
